player: pkg-1/player/incant_game_player --package data --window (ordinary composed player, exec-launched child of tools/launch.sh, which waits and records the real exit status)

event_mechanisms.keys: CGEvent keyDown/keyUp, US virtual key codes, kCGHIDEventTap; Shift/Option as real flagsChanged
event_mechanisms.live_composition: U.S. layout dead key Option-E then E: macOS marked text then commit (not synthetic)
event_mechanisms.unicode_text: CGEvent key events carrying a Unicode string, committed through the managed NSTextInputContext; not an Arabic layout or CJK input method
event_mechanisms.pointer: CGEvent mouseMoved/leftMouseDown/leftMouseUp at kCGHIDEventTap (one click, r2)
event_mechanisms.blur_refocus: System Events app activation of the previous front app, then of the player
event_mechanisms.close: AX close button press (CloseRequested), so the player prints its report

guards: every launch/burst waited for an unlocked awake display and 20 s HID idle (our own events count, so the wait is conservative); every event rechecked that the player was frontmost, the session unlocked and the pointer unmoved; the previous front app and pointer were restored

steps: Right; Tab -> Arabic (R1); End; key b
activate previous app: window blur with Name focused (R5)
raise; Tab x4 -> Name; End; key f; blur (R6)
refocus; Tab x5 -> Arabic; End; key g; blur (R7)
g in Arabic: UI focus was not restored
refocus; Tab x6 -> CJK; End; key h; blur (R8)
h in CJK; process alive 21 s later
AX close button with Name focused (R9 at loop exit)

r2-deadkey.purpose: live U.S. dead-key composition (Option-E) retired by blur, pointer focus change and close
steps: Tab x4 -> Name; End; keys " Byron"; Option-E
capture p2-01: live marked "´", underlined, IME caret
raise; Tab x5 -> Arabic; End; key e
plain e in Arabic: no dead-key carry-over
pointer click into CJK while marked (R3, composition active)
plain e in CJK: no "´" or "é" from the retired Name context
Shift-Tab -> Arabic (R4); Shift-Tab -> Name (R5); End; Option-E; key e
Option-E; AX close while marked (R6 at loop exit, composition active)
r2-deadkey.click_submit_note: The click focused CJK but did not submit it, so the crate stayed down. Inferred from source: focus loss cancelled the Name preedit, the display text changed, the layout generation advanced and UiInput cancelled the captured press, suppressing the release. A plain click into an unfocused field (0057) still submits; that limitation is unchanged.

retirement_definition: one event that ends the active native text session of a focused field: a focus change between fields, a window blur, or close with the field focused. Triggers and their consequences are observed; that each one retired and dropped exactly one managed client is inferred from view.rs set_text_input_session (one managed_text per view, old.retire() then drop) and window/ime.rs synchronize.
stale_text_events: discarded_stale_text_events was 0 in all three reports. It counts only stale-session TextInput events that reached the active player; callbacks to a retired client are dropped inside the client and are not observable from outside.
